PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF INFECTIOUS DISEASES ACT 1988

PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF INFECTIOUS DISEASES

(MEASURES WITHIN INFECTED LOCAL AREAS) (MOVEMENT CONTROL)

(NO. 4) (AMENDMENT) (NO. 12) REGULATIONS 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 11(2) of the

Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases Act 1988 [Act 342], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Prevention and Control

of Infectious Diseases (Measures within Infected Local Areas) (Movement Control)

(No. 4) (Amendment) (No. 12) Regulations 2021.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 25 April 2021.

Substitution of First Schedule

2. The Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases (Measures within

Infected Local Areas) (Movement Control) (No. 4) Regulations 2021

[P.U. (A) 96/2021] are amended by substituting for the First Schedule

the following schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

APPLICATION

[Regulation 2]

(1)

Infected Local Area/Division/District

(2)

Period

1. Tawau District, State of Sabah 17.4.2021 – 30.4.2021

2. Lahad Datu District, State of Sabah 25.4.2021 – 8.5.2021

3. Sandakan District, State of Sabah 17.4.2021 – 30.4.2021

4. State of Kelantan 22.4.2021 – 29.4.2021".

Made 24 April 2021

[KKM.600-29/4/146 Jld.2 (30); PN(PU2)470/Jld. 6]

DATO' SRI DR. ADHAM BIN BABA

Minister of Health
